proposals.title: Ratification of Termination Pay
proposals.topic_summary: Requests shareholder approval of senior manager pay packages with severance or termination payments exceeding 2.99 times base salary plus target short-term bonus.
proposals.evidence: the Board unanimously recommends that you vote "AGAINST" this shareholder proposal

proposals.title: Independent Board Chairman Policy
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a policy requiring the Chairman of the Board and the CEO to be separate persons, with the Chairman preferably independent.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Transfer of Intellectual Property to Potential COVID-19 Manufacturers Feasibility Report
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a third-party report on feasibility of transferring COVID-19 vaccine IP and know-how to manufacturers in low- and middle-income countries.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Impact of Extended Patent Exclusivities on Product Access Report
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a process and public report on how the impact of extended patent exclusivities on product access is considered when filing secondary and tertiary patents.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Political Contributions Congruency Report
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annual report analyzing congruency of political, lobbying and electioneering expenditures with stated company values, including reproductive health and women's equality.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.
